issue.title: Make unread acks stick and keep the Agents TUI responsive
issue.description: Unread acknowledgments (`,u`, `,j`/`,J`, row-select) are never reverted by another notification-store writer or by an older snapshot, and unread actions paint within budget: no UI-thread store reads, no full Agents rebuilds for unread-only changes, and no multi-second main-loop freezes from the 1 Hz runtime tick or fleet reprojection.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202609/unread_ack_reliability_and_tui_responsiveness.md requests this work

issue.title: Remote-attention reconciler writes only the rows it changed
issue.description: reconciler-delta-write: stop reconcile_remote_attention_inbox from handing every store row back to rewrite_notifications, and ignore per-poll observed_at churn in change detection, with a lost-update interleave regression test.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/unread_ack_reliability_and_tui_responsiveness.md defines phase reconciler-delta-write as one work unit

issue.title: Atomic field-scoped reconcile write in sase-core
issue.description: core-reconcile-upsert: add a lock-held, field-scoped notification reconcile write plus empty raw_suffix matcher parity to sase_core, bind it with the GIL released, switch the attention reconciler to it, and move the core pin.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/unread_ack_reliability_and_tui_responsiveness.md defines phase core-reconcile-upsert as one work unit

issue.title: Roster generation counter and cached projection index

issue.title: Sequence-fenced pending-ack overlay and monotonic snapshot cache
issue.description: pending-ack-fence: stamp snapshot reads with a read sequence, keep in-flight acks as a pending overlay every reconcile path honors, reject stale snapshots in the cache, narrow failure restore to owned identities, and stop re-confirmations from invalidating undo.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/unread_ack_reliability_and_tui_responsiveness.md defines phase pending-ack-fence as one work unit

issue.title: One batched unread chrome helper with no full rebuilds
issue.description: unread-chrome-helper: route every unread change through one helper that patches only visible changed rows via an identity map, skips collapsed panels, never falls back to a full rebuild, and refreshes titles, info panel, machine chip/tab strip and tribe summary once each.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/unread_ack_reliability_and_tui_responsiveness.md defines phase unread-chrome-helper as one work unit

issue.title: Precise bulk-ack scope and a time-bound explicit undo
issue.description: bulk-ack-scope-and-undo: make the bulk-ack target set share one predicate with the header unread count across tabs, collapsed clans and tribes, and replace the silent toggle with a toast-announced 10 second undo window.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/unread_ack_reliability_and_tui_responsiveness.md defines phase bulk-ack-scope-and-undo as one work unit

issue.title: Read-free ack completion and a coalescing ack writer
issue.description: ack-pipeline: delete the synchronous post-ack store read, apply ack outcomes to the cached snapshot by id, schedule only the guarded async resync, and drain queued acks through one coalescing worker that issues one Rust call per batch.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/unread_ack_reliability_and_tui_responsiveness.md defines phase ack-pipeline as one work unit

issue.title: Cheap unread jumps and footer probe
issue.description: unread-jump-fast-path: drop the unconditional trailing tab refresh from the unread jump keys, keep detail behind the debounce, reveal only the target panel, make the footer probe O(1), and key the jump-candidate cache by generations with remove-on-ack.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/unread_ack_reliability_and_tui_responsiveness.md defines phase unread-jump-fast-path as one work unit

issue.title: Cached wait-status maps and change-only runtime patching
issue.description: runtime-tick-caches: cache collect_agent_wait_status_maps per roster generation, patch runtime rows only when their rendered runtime text changes, and cache clan runtime aggregation so the 1 Hz tick stops freezing the loop.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/unread_ack_reliability_and_tui_responsiveness.md defines phase runtime-tick-caches as one work unit

issue.title: Cheap fleet reprojection signature computed before projection

issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/unread_ack_reliability_and_tui_responsiveness.md defines phase fleet-signature-cheap as one work unit

issue.title: Rust ack API, lean unread index, and store generations
issue.description: core-unread-ack-index: move completion acks and the unread completion index into sase_core as lean GIL-released calls that return dismissed ids and a store generation, then replace the Python read-sequence fence with store generations.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/unread_ack_reliability_and_tui_responsiveness.md defines phase core-unread-ack-index as one work unit
